memories.text: Appointment booked for new patient review of COPD symptoms. Visit scheduled for 2025-04-15 at 10:00 am with Dr Priya Natarajan (D03).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Initial assessment of COPD.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: The patient reports occasional breathlessness on exertion and morning cough with clear sputum. He uses salbutamol inhaler as needed.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/78 mmHg, weight 78 kg, height 1.70 m, BMI 27.0 (obese). SpO2 94% on room air. Respiratory rate 18/min, mild wheeze bilaterally.
IMPRESSION: COPD, GOLD stage II. Overweight, needs lifestyle advice.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start tiotropium inhaler 18 mcg OD, salbutamol inhaler 100 mcg SOS, budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg inhaler BD. Order fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, spirometry, chest X-ray. Advise weight reduction, smoking cessation (non-smoker), annual influenza vaccine. Return if: worsening breathlessness, chest pain, fever >39°C, or increased sputum purulence.

memories.text: Spirometry: FEV1 1.68 L (58% predicted), FVC 2.80 L (85% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.60 (60%). Consistent with moderate obstructive defect.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Chest X-ray: Hyperinflated lungs, flattened diaphragms, no focal consolidation. No acute pathology.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Three-month COPD review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports improved exercise tolerance, uses salbutamol <2 times/week. No night symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 126/80, weight 76 kg, BMI 26.3 (overweight). SpO2 95%.
IMPRESSION: COPD stable. Overweight persists; lipids show borderline LDL.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue tiotropium OD, salbutamol SOS, increase budesonide-formoterol to 200/6 mcg BD (already). Reinforce diet, activity, weight target <75 kg. Annual influenza vaccine due in October. Return if: worsening dyspnea, wheeze, fever >39°C, or sputum change.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Six-month COPD follow-up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports occasional mild breathlessness on climbing stairs, uses salbutamol 2-3 times/week.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/82, weight 75 kg, BMI 25.9 (overweight). SpO2 94%.
IMPRESSION: COPD stable, slight symptomatic burden. Overweight continues.
ARRANGEMENTS: Maintain current inhaler regimen. Advise low‑salt diet, increase aerobic activity to 150 min/week. Offer influenza vaccine today (date 2025-12-01). Return if: increased breathlessness at rest, chest pain, fever >39°C, or sputum purulence.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Annual COPD review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient states breathlessness unchanged, uses salbutamol SOS 1-2 times/week, no exacerbations since last visit.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/80, weight 73 kg, BMI 25.2 (overweight). SpO2 95%.
IMPRESSION: COPD stable. Lipids improved; fasting glucose normal.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order fasting lipid profile and fasting blood sugar (annual). Continue current inhalers. Reinforce weight reduction to <70 kg. Influenza vaccine given 2025-12-01, next due autumn 2026. Return if: worsening dyspnea, chest pain, fever >39°C, or hemoptysis.
